en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abdah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: We came to Madinah while it was unhealthy. Abu Bakr became ill and Bilal became ill. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw the illness of his companions, he said: O Allah, make us love Madinah as You made us love Makkah, or more. Make it healthy for us, bless its sa and its mudd, and transfer its fever to al-Juhfah.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abdah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: We came to Medina while it was unhealthy. Abu Bakr became ill and Bilal became ill. When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) saw the illness of his companions, he said: O Allah, make us love Medina as You made us love Makka, or more. Make it healthy for us, segne its sa and its mudd, and transfer its fever to al-Juhfah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Usamah and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, with this chain and a similar meaning.
de: Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, with this chain and a similar meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Uthman ibn Umar narrated to us. Isa ibn Hafs ibn Asim informed us. Nafi narrated to us, from Ibn Umar. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whoever is patient through its hardship, I will be his intercessor or witness on the Day of Resurrection.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Uthman ibn Umar überlieferte uns. Isa ibn Hafs ibn Asim berichtete uns. Nafi überlieferte uns, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Whoever is patient through its Not, I will be his intercessor or witness on the Tag der Auferstehung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Qatan ibn Wahb ibn Uwaymir ibn al-Ajda, from Yuhannis, the freedman of al-Zubayr, who informed him that he was sitting with Abd Allah ibn Umar during the turmoil. A female servant of his came to greet him and said: I intend to leave, Abu Abd al-Rahman; times have become hard for us. Abd Allah said to her: Sit down, foolish woman. I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: No one is patient through its hardship and difficulty except that I will be his witness or intercessor on the Day of Resurrection.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Qatan ibn Wahb ibn Uwaymir ibn al-Ajda, from Yuhannis, the freedman of al-Zubayr, who informed him that he was sitting with Abd Allah ibn Umar during the turmoil. A female servant of his came to greet him and said: I intend to leave, Abu Abd al-Rahman; times have become hard for us. Abd Allah said to her: Sit down, foolish woman. I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: No one is patient through its Not and Schwierigkeit except that I will be his witness or intercessor on the Tag der Auferstehung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Rafi narrated to us. Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us. Al-Dahhak informed us, from Qatan al-Khuza'i, from Yuhannis, the freedman of Musab, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whoever is patient through its hardship and difficulty, I will be his witness or intercessor on the Day of Resurrection, meaning Madinah.
de: Ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Ibn Abi Fudayk berichtete uns. Al-Dahhak berichtete uns, from Qatan al-Khuza'i, from Yuhannis, the freedman of Musab, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Whoever is patient through its Not and Schwierigkeit, I will be his witness or intercessor on the Tag der Auferstehung, meaning Medina. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one from my community is patient through the hardship and difficulty of Madinah except that I will be his intercessor on the Day of Resurrection or his witness.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: No one from my community is patient through the Not and Schwierigkeit of Medina except that I will be his intercessor on the Tag der Auferstehung or his witness. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa, who heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa, who heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yusuf ibn Isa narrated to us. Al-Fadl ibn Musa narrated to us. Hisham ibn Urwah informed us, from Salih ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one is patient through the hardship of Madinah. He said the same.
de: Yusuf ibn Isa überlieferte uns. Al-Fadl ibn Musa überlieferte uns. Hisham ibn Urwah berichtete uns, from Salih ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one is patient through the Not of Medina. He said the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nuaim ibn Abd Allah, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: At the entrances of Madinah are angels. Neither plague nor the Dajjal will enter it.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nuaim ibn Abd Allah, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: At the entrances of Medina are Engel. Neither plague nor the Dajjal will enter it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far. Al-Ala informed me, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The Messiah will come from the east, intending Madinah, until he descends behind Uhud. Then the angels will turn his face toward Syria, and there he will perish.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far. Al-Ala berichtete mir, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: The Messiah will come from the east, intending Medina, until he descends behind Uhud. Then the Engel will turn his face toward Syria, and there he will perish. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz, meaning al-Darawardi, narrated to us, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A time will come upon people when a man will call his cousin and relative, saying: Come to prosperity, come to prosperity. Madinah is better for them, if they knew. By the One in whose hand is my soul, no one leaves it out of dislike for it except that Allah replaces him there with someone better than him. Madinah is like a furnace: it removes the impure. The Hour will not come until Madinah expels its wicked people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz, meaning al-Darawardi, überlieferte uns, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A time will come upon people when a man will call his cousin and relative, saying: Come to prosperity, come to prosperity. Medina is better for them, if they knew. By the One in whose hand is my soul, no one leaves it out of dislike for it except that Allah replaces him there with someone better than him. Medina is like a furnace: it removes the impure. The Hour will not come until Medina expels its wicked people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Yahya ibn Sa'id. He said: I heard Abu al-Hubab, Sa'id ibn Yasar, say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I was commanded regarding a city that consumes cities. They call it Yathrib, but it is Madinah. It expels people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Yahya ibn Sa'id. Er sagte: I heard Abu al-Hubab, Sa'id ibn Yasar, say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I was commanded regarding a city that consumes cities. They call it Yathrib, but it is Medina. It expels people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Amr al-Naqid and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us. H; Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. All of them narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain. They said: As a furnace expels impurity. They did not mention iron.
de: Amr al-Naqid and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns. H; Ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Wahhab überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain. They said: As a furnace expels impurity. They did not mention iron. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, that a desert Arab pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). A fever struck him in Madinah, so he came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: Muhammad, release me from my pledge. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) refused. He came again and said it, and he refused. He came a third time and said it, and he refused. The desert Arab then left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Madinah is like a furnace; it removes its impurities and makes its good pure.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, that a desert Arab pledged allegiance to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). A fever struck him in Medina, so he came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: Muhammad, release me from my pledge. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) refused. He came again and said it, and he refused. He came a third time and said it, and he refused. The desert Arab then left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Medina is like a furnace; it removes its impurities and makes its good pure. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh, al-Anbari, narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Adi, Ibn Thabit, who heard Abd Allah ibn Yazid, from Zayd ibn Thabit, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: It is good, meaning Madinah, and it removes impurity as fire removes the impurity of silver.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh, al-Anbari, überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Adi, Ibn Thabit, who heard Abd Allah ibn Yazid, from Zayd ibn Thabit, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: It is good, meaning Medina, and it removes impurity as fire removes the impurity of silver. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Hannad ibn al-Sari, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah said: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Allah Most High named Madinah Tabah.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Hannad ibn al-Sari, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah said: Abu al-Ahwas überlieferte uns, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Allah Most High named Medina Tabah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar narrated to me. They said: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Both narrated from Ibn Jurayj. Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yuhannis informed me, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he said: I testify concerning Abu Hurayra that he said: Abu al-Qasim (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends evil for the people of this city, meaning Madinah, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar überlieferte mir. They said: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Both narrated from Ibn Jurayj. Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yuhannis berichtete mir, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he said: I testify concerning Abu Hurayra that he said: Abu al-Qasim (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends Böses for the people of this city, meaning Medina, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar narrated to me. They said: Hajjaj narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. All narrated from Ibn Jurayj, who said: Amr ibn Yahya ibn Umarah informed me that he heard al-Qarraz, one of the companions of Abu Hurayra, claim that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends evil for its people, meaning Madinah, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water. Ibn Hatim's hadith says 'evil' instead of 'harm'.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar überlieferte mir. They said: Hajjaj überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to me. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. All narrated from Ibn Jurayj, who said: Amr ibn Yahya ibn Umarah berichtete mir that he heard al-Qarraz, one of the companions of Abu Hurayra, claim that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends Böses for its people, meaning Medina, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. Ibn Hatim's hadith says 'Böses' instead of 'harm'. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa. H; Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Al-Darawardi narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Amr. Both heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz hear Abu Hurayra from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa. H; Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Al-Darawardi überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Amr. Both heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz hear Abu Hurayra from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Hatim, meaning Ibn Ismail, narrated to us, from Umar ibn Nubayh. Dinar al-Qarraz informed me. He said: I heard Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends evil for the people of Madinah, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Hatim, meaning Ibn Ismail, überlieferte uns, from Umar ibn Nubayh. Dinar al-Qarraz berichtete mir. Er sagte: I heard Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends Böses for the people of Medina, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ja'far, narrated to us, from Umar ibn Nubayh al-Ka'bi, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he heard Sa'd ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same, except that he said: with harm or evil.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ja'far, überlieferte uns, from Umar ibn Nubayh al-Ka'bi, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he heard Sa'd ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same, except that he said: with harm or Böses. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to us. Usamah ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz. He said: I heard him say: I heard Abu Hurayra and Sa'd say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: O Allah, bless the people of Madinah in their mudd. Then he related the hadith, including: Whoever intends evil for its people, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa überlieferte uns. Usamah ibn Zayd überlieferte uns, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz. Er sagte: I heard him say: I heard Abu Hurayra and Sa'd say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: O Allah, segne the people of Medina in their mudd. Then he related the hadith, including: Whoever intends Böses for its people, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Waki narrated to us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Syria will be conquered, and people will leave Madinah with their families seeking easy living, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew. Then Yemen will be conquered, and people will leave Madinah with their families seeking easy living, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew. Then Iraq will be conquered, and people will leave Madinah with their families seeking easy living, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Waki überlieferte uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Syria will be conquered, and people will leave Medina with their families seeking easy living, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Then Yemen will be conquered, and people will leave Medina with their families seeking easy living, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Then Iraq will be conquered, and people will leave Medina with their families seeking easy living, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Yemen will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew. Then Syria will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew. Then Iraq will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew.

Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr, who said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Yemen will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Then Syria will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Then Iraq will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Abu Safwan narrated to us, from Yunus ibn Yazid. H; Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me, and this is his wording. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, who heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said of Madinah: Its people will leave it in the best state it ever had, leaving it to the animals, meaning predators and birds. Muslim said: Abu Safwan was Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Malik, the orphan of Ibn Jurayj, who had been in his care for ten years.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Abu Safwan überlieferte uns, from Yunus ibn Yazid. H; Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir, and this is his wording. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, who heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said of Medina: Its people will leave it in the best state it ever had, leaving it to the animals, meaning predators and birds. Muslim said: Abu Safwan was Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Malik, the orphan of Ibn Jurayj, who had been in his care for ten years. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth narrated to me. My father narrated to me, from my grandfather. Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me that Abu Hurayra said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: They will leave Madinah in the best state it ever had; only the animals will approach it, meaning predators and birds. Then two shepherds from Muzaynah will head toward Madinah, calling to their sheep. They will find it deserted, and when they reach the mountain pass of al-Wada, they will fall upon their faces.
de: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth überlieferte mir. My father überlieferte mir, from my grandfather. Uqayl ibn Khalid überlieferte mir, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib berichtete mir that Abu Hurayra said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: They will leave Medina in the best state it ever had; only the animals will approach it, meaning predators and birds. Then two shepherds from Muzaynah will head toward Medina, calling to their sheep. They will find it deserted, and when they reach the Berg pass of al-Wada, they will fall upon their faces. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Mazini, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Between my house and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Mazini, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Between my Haus and my Kanzel is a garden from the gardens of Paradies. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad al-Madani informed us, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Ansari, that he heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Between my pulpit and my house is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad al-Madani berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Ansari, that he heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Between my Kanzel and my Haus is a garden from the gardens of Paradies. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. They said: Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. H; Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Between my house and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is upon my basin.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. They said: Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. H; Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Between my Haus and my Kanzel is a garden from the gardens of Paradies, and my Kanzel is upon my basin. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi narrated to us. Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. He said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the expedition to Tabuk. He related the hadith, including: We came to Wadi al-Qura, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain behind. We went on until Madinah came into view, and he said: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a mountain that loves us and we love it.
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi überlieferte uns. Sulayman ibn Bilal überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. Er sagte: We went out with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the expedition to Tabuk. He related the hadith, including: We came to Wadi al-Qura, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain behind. We went on until Medina came into view, and he said: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a Berg that loves us and we love it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
